content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated p99 token latency on streaming endpoints (us-west-2). p99 sustained > 1.1s for 12m. KV cache eviction_rate has spiked ~5.5x. Prefill_vs_decode imbalance metric indicates prefill task CPU >> decode CPU causing worker queueing. Severity SEV2. Paging oncall.

maria: oncall here, ack. creating incident INC-2991. grabbing dashboards and span tails. first glance at kv metrics.

david: i see eviction bursts at 13:12:02; eviction_count ~ spike to 18k/min. streaming_write stalls correlate with increased prefill_latency. p95 jumped from 180ms -> 420ms, p99 ~1.1-1.4s.

anita: any recent runtime changes or autoscaler churn? ops-bot?

ops-bot: recent infra events: autoscaler resized enc-pool-3 twice between 12:58-13:05 for CPU pressure. No user-facing deploys in last 3h.

maria: ok autoscaler churn could have warmed-down cache slices. david, can you check fragment map + free_segments?

david: fragment_map shows high fragmentation: small fragments (<1KB) count up 4x. free_segments dropped to 9% from typical 25%. LRU churn high; large keys being evicted while many small keys remain, causing lots of prefill disk reads.

anita: customer impact? cs-bot?

cs-bot: CS telemetry: ~0.35% increase in client visible timeouts (client 1s threshold), 6 customers reported degraded streaming quality in last 15m, highest user-visible errors on long-session chat flows.

maria: short-term mitigations: 1) reduce prefill concurrency on enc-pool-3 from 20 -> 6 2) increase kv_cache_target_mb for enc-pool-3 nodes by +2GB each 3) enable session-length-based routing to send >2k-token sessions to fallback lower-memory variant 4) temporarily enable cache-compact simulated pass every 10m on a single node for trial. executing now in that order.

david: applying prefill throttle now. curl command:
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://console.internal.redwood/api/pools/enc-pool-3/config \
  -d '{"prefill_max_concurrency":6}'
```
ops-bot: config change applied to enc-pool-3 at 2991234159 by david.

maria: bumping kv cache target via runtime-api on node enc-3b: target_kv_cache_mb 4096 -> 6144. doing incremental + watch.

anita: starting a staged compact job on enc-3a to test compaction benefits (single node only). starting now.

david: early signal: after prefill throttle p99 dropped ~40% to ~0.7-0.8s, p95 ~210-260ms. eviction_rate down ~60%. streaming stall alerts reduced.

maria: good. continue monitoring. David, collect heap/fragmentation snapshot and top-customer keys causing thrash. We'll need to identify noisy sessions to route.

david: capturing heap + kv debug dump now; uploading to S3: s3://internal-incident-dumps/INC-2991/fragmentation-dump-2991234210.tar.gz

cs-bot: CS provided an initial noisy-customer list: cust-orion, cust-vela, cust-nyx (long chat histories). flagged for routing.

anita: medium-term plan: 1) implement size-aware eviction policy (evict by byte-size, not by item count) 2) add periodic compaction and reclamation job to defragment segments 3) session pinning for enterprise/noisy customers 4) add alert for fragmentation ratio > 30% and free_segments < 12% 5) make prefill work-stealing backoff when decode pool saturated.

maria: agree. open followups with owners. david please start a design doc for size-aware eviction and schedule a small spike to validate.

david: will open PR and doc. link: https://docs.internal.redwood/eviction-size-aware-draft (WIP).

anita: runbook updates while mitigated: add a prefill-throttle knob and cache-bump checklist, include rollback if node memory > 92% or OOMs occur.

ops-bot: memory on enc-3b increased by ~7% after cache bump, currently at 74%, no OOM. eviction_rate continuing to decline.

maria: metrics summary 30m post-mitigation: p99 decreased from ~1.35s -> ~0.72s, p95 back to baseline ~230ms, client timeouts down to +0.05% above baseline. customer reports falling. marking incident as mitigated but not resolved.

anita: preparing postmortem checklist: timeline, metrics, commands used to mitigate (include curl and runtime ops), customer impact summary, long term action items and owners. assign to eng-runtime for root-cause code change.

maria: handoff: I'll hand to night oncall david_night in 45m. please keep throttle + cache bump for 24h while we validate. if memory > 90% roll back cache bump immediately.

david: taking over on night watch. will keep alert thresholds tight for fragmentation and memory. if we see re-regression, i'll escalate to oncall-2 and product to route noisy customers.

anita: incident ticket INC-2991 updated: status->mitigated, assignee->david, sla_breach->yes.

maria: final notes: mitigations reduced user impact to acceptable levels. next steps: size-aware eviction PR, compaction job spec, per-customer pinning work, observability alert for fragmentation. collecting logs/traces into incident bundle. links: dash: https://dashboards.internal.redwood/INC-2991-kv-frag, traces: https://traces.internal.redwood/2991234000, bundle: https://s3.internal/INC-2991/bundle.zip

david: acknowledged. monitoring until 2991235620 then i'll close ticket if stable. thanks team. :heart:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2991 marked mitigated at 2991235240.

(END OF THREAD)
